extracted.intended_audience: emerging writers, literary community, and general readers seeking information about the Whiting Awards
extracted.subtask_description: Summarize the Whiting Awards' purpose, eligibility, categories, selection process, award amounts, and the related Literary Magazine Prizes for nonprofit magazines. The page documents who the awards target and how winners are chosen and funded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award purpose / eligibility: Achievement by emerging writers
rubrics_metrics.description: The Whiting Award is an American award presented annually to ten emerging writers in fiction, nonfiction, poetry and drama.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The award is sponsored by the Mrs. Giles Whiting Foundation and has been presented since 1985.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award categories
rubrics_metrics.description: The awards are given in four categories: fiction, nonfiction, poetry, and drama.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The recipients list on the page is organized by year and category (fiction, nonfiction, poetry, drama), reflecting category-based selection of honorees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of winners and frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: The Whiting Awards are presented annually to ten emerging writers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First awarded in 1985; the article lists winners year-by-year. (As of 2021, winners receive US$50,000.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection process: juried nominations and committee selection
rubrics_metrics.description: The nominees are chosen through a juried process, and the final winners are selected by a committee of writers, scholars, and editors, selected each year by the Foundation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection is multi-stage (jury then committee) with the committee composed of writers, scholars, and editors chosen annually by the Foundation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nomination policy: no self-nominations / unsolicited nominations not accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: Writers cannot apply for the prize themselves, and the Foundation does not accept unsolicited nominations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a by-nomination/by-jury award rather than an open-application fellowship/grant; prospective candidates do not submit applications directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prize amount (Whiting Awards)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page notes the award amount and its date ("As of 2021 [update], winners receive US$50,000").

rubrics_metrics.name: Literary Magazine Prizes: eligibility and grant structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Since 2018, the foundation has also awarded Literary Magazine Prizes to US-based nonprofit publications whose audience is adult readers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize-winning magazines are invited to work with the Foundation over the course of three years and receive outright grants of $10,000–$20,000 in the first year followed by matching grants in the second and third years.
